Name: Sprinkler Pet Bowls
Author: yanduu8uuu
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
A lightweight SMAPI mod that allows sprinklers to automatically fill pet bowls with water when the bowl is within sprinkler range.
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Install SMAPI, then extract the
[code]SprinklerPetBowls[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder. Launch the game through SMAPI. No configuration is required.
[b]Main features[/b]
Automatically fills pet bowls when they are within sprinkler range. Uses the game's sprinkler coverage, works automatically each day, and requires no configuration.
[b]Requirements[/b]
Requires Stardew Valley 1.6 or later and SMAPI.
[b]Shout outs[/b]
Thanks to ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley, Pathoschild and the SMAPI contributors for the modding framework, and the Stardew Valley modding community for documentation and resources.
